player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Chopsticks. On your turn, choose one of:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=your hand (0 or 1), O=opponent hand (0 or 1).
    - Opponent's hand count increases by your hand; if >=5, it becomes 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  to redistribute your total fingers into L and R (L+R = your total).
Reply with exactly one of those commands.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Muntu yina ke pesa ve maboko {opp_idx} me fwa dezia.
invalid_move.split_sum: Kana beto kabula yo, ntalu na yo fwete vanda {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Yo fwete vanda nde Split mebalula mutindu nge ketambusaka maboko na nge.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Hatua batili. Utumie “[attack M O]” au “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} akiluka mkono wa P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: unatoka {opp_val} hadi {new_val}.

outcome.win: Bakala ti nkento yina ke nwana me fwa.
outcome.draw: Beto me kuma na nsuka ya kitamina yina beto fwete baluka.
